title.en: Side project becomes the main band

summary.en: "Just jamming with friends" ships a better album than the day job.
summary.zh: 「跟朋友随便玩一下」——结果比正职那张盘还好听。

body.en:
Dave Grohl starts Foo Fighters as a one-man tape project after Nirvana. Josh Homme stacks Queens, Eagles of Death Metal, and Them Crooked Vultures like side hustles with chart teeth.

Rule of thumb: if the "side" band has its own Wikipedia drama and merch table, it is not a side project anymore.
body.zh:
Dave Grohl 在 Nirvana 之后用一人录音做成 Foo Fighters。Josh Homme 把 Queens、Eagles of Death Metal、Them Crooked Vultures 叠成带排行榜牙齿的「副业」。

经验法则：如果「副业」已经有自己的维基撕逼和周边摊，那就不是副业了。

note.en: Started as Grohl’s solo demos; became the day job.
note.zh: 从 Grohl 一人 demo 变成正职。

note.en: Homme / Jones / Grohl: side project with a stadium résumé.
note.zh: Homme / Jones / Grohl：简历能填体育馆的副业。
